hook: TG-iPASS portal hit by *ransomware*; probe points to Turkey
hook_b: TG-iPASS portal hit by *ransomware*; probe points to Turkey
tldr: The Telangana Cyber Security Bureau is investigating a suspected ransomware attack on the TG-iPASS industrial clearances portal on October 22.

beats.what: Investigators have reportedly identified hackers operating from Turkey; the attack encrypted the database and renamed files with a '.vgb' extension.
beats.why: TG-iPASS is the state's single-window portal for industrial clearances; services were disrupted until restored from backups.
beats.care: Forensic experts are checking whether sensitive data was stolen or moved outside the system.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: A case was registered under Sections 43 and 66 of the IT Act after a complaint by the Industries Department.

cards.q: Do you trust government portals with your data?

qs: Was any applicant or company data copied before encryption?
Why did the hackers keep changing IP addresses?

facts.t: The case is filed under *two* IT Act sections, 43 and 66.

viz.verdict: A state portal was breached; the extent is still being probed

learn.t: Ransomware = malware that locks (encrypts) a system's files, usually followed by a demand to unlock them

watch: The forensic finding on whether any data left the system.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Telangana cyber bureau probes ransomware attack on TG-iPASS website

fact: Ransomware encrypted Telangana's *TG-iPASS* industry portal; probe points to Turkey-based hackers
twist: The ransom note left only an email address, with *no money demanded*.
